title: hahnia aria glabrata
intro: Hahnia aria glabrata, commonly known as Himalayan Balsam or Polic's Balsam, is a perennial flowering plant native to the Himalayan region and parts of Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Himalayan Balsam include reducing inflammation, relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, and serving as an antibacterial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
